data.name: Ashaab
data.long_meaning: In Islamic history, Ashaab refers to the companions of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who supported and aided him during his mission in Makkah and Madinah. The name Ashaab is derived from the Arabic root sh-h-b, meaning to help or support.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of unity, brotherhood, and support in the path of righteousness.
data.numerology_meaning: People with the name Ashaab possess strong leadership qualities and are natural problem solvers. They are empathetic and compassionate, always putting others before themselves.

in_arabic.name: أصحاب
in_arabic.meaning: أصحاب تعني الأصحاب أو الجماعة أو القوم
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أصحاب مشتق من أصل عربي 'صحب' والذي يعني الاقتران والصحبة. في القرآن الكريم، يرد اسم أصحاب في عدة مواضع مثل أصحاب الجنة وأصحاب النار، ويعني هنا جماعة من الناس إما في الخير أو الشر. اسم أصحاب ذو دلالة على الاجتماع والتواصل بين الأفراد، ويحمل في طياته معاني الوداد والتعاون.

in_urdu.name: اصحاب
in_urdu.meaning: اصحاب کا مطلب ہے دوستوں کا گروہ یا صحابی
in_urdu.long_meaning: اصحاب نام کی اصل عربی ہے 'صحب' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے صحبت کرنا یا ساتھ گزرنا۔ اسلامی تقویم میں اصحاب سے مراد وہ لوگ ہیں جو رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کے ساتھ تھے اور ان کی صحبت میں تھے۔ یہ نام جنوب ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں بہت مقبول ہے کیونکہ یہ دینی و تاریخی حوالوں سے مالا مال ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अश्हाब
in_hindi.meaning: अश्हाब का अर्थ है मित्रों का समूह या साथी
in_hindi.long_meaning: अश्हाब नाम की उत्पत्ति العربية मूल 'صحب' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है साथ रहना या मित्रता करना। इस्लामी परंपरा में अश्हाब का नाम उन व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो पैगंबर मुहम्मद صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم के साथी थे। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत महत्व रखता है क्योंकि यह आध्यात्मिक और ऐतिहासिक संदर्भों से समृद्ध है।

in_pashto.name: اصحاب
in_pashto.meaning: اصحاب د ملګرو ډله یا قوم معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: د اصحاب نوم اصل عربي 'صحب' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د ملګرتی یا یوځای تګ معنی ورکوي. په افغان او پښتون دود کې، اصحاب د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي چې د پښتو پیړیو راهیسو د دیني او ټولنیزو اړیکو په پار تشویق شوي دي.

in_english.name: Ashaab
in_english.meaning: Ashaab means group of friends or companions
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ashaab originates from the Arabic root 'sahab', meaning to accompany or be in the company of. In Islamic tradition, Ashaab refers to the companions of Prophet Muhammad. The name carries connotations of camaraderie, fellowship, and togetherness. It is used across various Muslim cultures to signify a sense of community and belonging.

data.cultural_impact: The term Ashaab holds immense importance in Islamic history and culture as it represents the first generation of Muslims who accepted and spread the teachings of Islam. Their unwavering support and dedication to the Prophet (pbuh) during tough times served as an inspiration for future generations.
data.spiritual_significance: Ashaab are considered the Sahabah Rashidun, or the rightly-guided caliphs, who lived under the close guidance of the Prophet (pbuh) and strictly adhered to his teachings. Their spiritual impact is vast as they guided and shaped the Muslim community, passing down crucial Islamic knowledge and traditions for future generations. Their unwavering commitment to prayer, fasting, and charity remains an example for Muslims today, embodying the core principles of the Islamic faith.

historical_references.context: A group of companions of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who were known for their piety and knowledge, particularly in interpretation of the Quran. This group included Ibn Masud, Abu Ad-Darda, and Salman Al-Farsi.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ashaab al-Ansar (People of Medina) The name Ashaab carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The indigenous inhabitants of Medina who welcomed and supported Muhammad and his emigrant followers (Muhajirun) during the early Islamic period. Among them were Sa'd ibn Mu'adh, Ali ibn Abi Talib, and Salman Al-Farsi.
